summary: All 3 fixes from this iteration verified on web (Chromium, 390x844). (1) HAPTICS ON WEB: Monkey-patched navigator.vibrate via add_init_script. Haptics ON by default. Oyna press -> 1 vibrate call. ArrowLeft + ArrowRight (lane change) -> 2 vibrate calls (1 per lane). During a ~25s run that ended in a crash, gameplay+crash fired 7 vibrate calls (jumps/rolls from autoplay swipes + crash notification). settings-haptics-test-button -> 1 vibrate call. Toggling settings-haptics-switch ON->OFF -> 0 vibrate (correct, code only pulses when v=true); subsequent OFF->ON -> 1 vibrate pulse (expected). No console errors from expo-haptics (0 haptics-related errors). Platform.OS==='web' guards are gone — expo-haptics is reaching navigator.vibrate successfully. (2) RESET DATA TWO-TAP: After a run yielded bestScore=41 and coins=5, opened Settings. Reset button label before any tap: 'Yerel skorları sıfırla'. After 1st tap: 'Emin misin? Tekrar dokun' (confirmReset state engaged). After 2nd tap: label reverts to 'Yerel skorları sıfırla' AND menu-best becomes 0, menu-coins becomes 0, Leaderboard Yerel tab shows leaderboard-empty with 'Henüz koşu yok. İlk rekorunu kır!'. (3) ENGINE.TS WEB REGRESSION: Game canvas rendered (game-canvas visible), intro->menu->Oyna fired, HUD score mounted during gameplay, crash triggered game-over-sheet, game-over-home-button navigated back to menu. ZERO 'WebGL 1 is not supported' errors in console; the only WebGL-related log is a harmless three.js warning 'PCFSoftShadowMap has been removed. Using PCFShadowMap instead.' plus a GPU-stall perf advisory from the headless Chromium driver — neither indicates the r163 regression. Web code path is unaffected (Platform.OS==='web' skips the WebGLRenderingContext hide block in engine.ts:151). (4) Backend regression: 17/17 pytest pass (16 test_api.py + 1 test_soft_delete.py) in 3.58s.
